header: Three promises we make to every service desk
subheadline: All three are part of the service agreement you sign. If we miss either of the first two in a calendar month, you get service credits.

items.title: 99.95% uptime, measured monthly
items.description: Measured on the dispatch board and the mobile sync endpoint and published on the status page. If we fall short, we credit the next invoice.

items.title: Your data stays in the EU
items.description: Records are stored in Frankfurt and Vienna, replicated between both. We have held ISO 27001 certification since 2023 and name every subprocessor on request.

items.title: A person answers within two hours
items.description: Support runs from 07:00 to 19:00 CET on working days, in German and English. The people answering have dispatched crews themselves.
